IPA Upload API - LLM Integration Guide

Purpose
- Upload .ipa files with token auth.
- For .ipa uploads, automatically generate iOS OTA manifest + install links.

Base URL
- Use your deployed API base URL, e.g. https://api.example.com
- Health endpoint: GET /health

Auth
- Header required on protected endpoints:
  Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>

Environment Requirements
- API_TOKEN: required secret token.
- PUBLIC_BASE_URL: required for iOS OTA flow; must be HTTPS and reachable by iOS devices.
- Files are served from /uploads/*.

Endpoints

1) GET /health
- Auth: none
- Response 200:
  { "ok": true }

2) POST /upload
- Auth: required
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Form field: file
- Allowed extensions: .ipa

Success Responses

A) .ipa upload (201)
{
  "message": "Upload successful",
  "filename": "MyApp-1716976800000.ipa",
  "originalName": "MyApp.ipa",
  "size": 12345678,
  "ipaUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000.ipa",
  "manifestUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000-manifest.plist",
  "installUrl": "itms-services://?action=download-manifest&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdownloads.example.com%2Fuploads%2FMyApp-1716976800000-manifest.plist",
  "installPageUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000-install.html",
  "bundleIdentifier": "com.example.myapp",
  "version": "1.2.3",
  "buildNumber": "42",
  "title": "My App"
}

IPA OTA Behavior
- Server extracts metadata from Payload/*.app/Info.plist:
  - CFBundleIdentifier
  - CFBundleVersion
  - CFBundleShortVersionString
  - CFBundleDisplayName (fallback CFBundleName)
- Server generates Apple manifest.plist and stores it in uploads.
- Server generates iOS install link:
  itms-services://?action=download-manifest&url=<url-encoded manifest https url>
- Server also generates a public install HTML page with an "Install App" button.

Error Responses
- Common shape:
  { "error": "<message>" }

- 401 Unauthorized:
  - Missing or invalid bearer token.

- 400 Bad Request examples:
  - Missing file field (use "file").
  - Only .ipa files are allowed.
  - Invalid IPA file: failed to read archive.
  - Invalid IPA file: Info.plist not found under Payload/*.app/.
  - Invalid IPA file: Info.plist is empty.
  - IPA metadata incomplete: ... required.
  - Generated manifest plist validation failed.
  - IPA URL must use HTTPS.
  - Manifest URL must use HTTPS.
  - Install page URL must use HTTPS.

Agent Usage Pattern
1) Call POST /upload with bearer token and file.
2) If response has installPageUrl, present it as primary action for iOS users.
3) Keep installUrl as fallback deep-link.
4) On errors, surface server message directly to user.
5) Do not ask users for bundle identifier/version when uploading IPA; server extracts it.

cURL Example
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@/absolute/path/to/app.ipa"
